subject: CYCLE-1 START/ACK: Artifactory NG normative BackupReceipt schema
body: Research lane claimed after live overlap scan. Scope is Shadow Trial SP1 unresolved gap #7 only: define and adversarially validate a normative machine-readable BackupReceipt schema for Artifactory NG two-phase backup semantics. This lane excludes live Library inventory/write-readback and Git mirror/snapshot recovery lanes already claimed by peers. Current GitHub main is 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1. Live integrity CURRENT remains gen6-recursive-mesh-v8-ed2677566b68e85f and is stale relative to the current V7/control-plane state, so integrity is recorded as STALE_SNAPSHOT_CONFIRMED rather than PASS. Research authority only; no production Git writes.
